stem: Which statement expresses a theme found in BOTH the story “The Antique Shop” and the poem “Don’t Go Into the Library”?

options.label: A
options.text: New perspectives and frames of mind can bring joy.

options.label: B
options.text: Making judgments based on appearances alone is foolish.

options.label: C
options.text: Answers to difficult questions are often found in unexpected places.

options.label: D
